<?php
/**
 * License key and automatic updates for {{NAME}}, sold on {{STORE_NAME}}.
 *
 * Generated by Rinnovo Subscriptions & Licenses. Put this file in your {{KIND}} folder and add these
 * two lines to your main {{KIND}} file ({{MAIN_HINT}}):
 *
 *     require_once __DIR__ . '/{{FILE}}';
 *     {{CLASS}}::init( __FILE__, '1.0.0' ); // Your {{KIND}}'s current version.
 *
 * Customers then get a "{{NAME}} license" screen ({{SCREEN_HINT}}) to enter their key, and updates
 * arrive in Dashboard > Updates like any other {{KIND}} while the key is active.
 *
 * @package {{CLASS}}
 */

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

if ( ! class_exists( '{{CLASS}}' ) ) {

	/**
	 * License client.
	 */
	class {{CLASS}} {

		const API     = '{{API}}';
		const PRODUCT = '{{PRODUCT_ID}}';
		const KIND    = '{{KIND}}';
		const OPTION  = '{{OPTION}}';

		/**
		 * Main file of the plugin, or the theme's functions.php.
		 *
		 * @var string
		 */
		private static $file = '';

		/**
		 * Installed version.
		 *
		 * @var string
		 */
		private static $version = '';

		/**
		 * Start.
		 *
		 * @param string $file    __FILE__ of the main plugin file (or functions.php for a theme).
		 * @param string $version Installed version.
		 */
		public static function init( $file, $version ) {
			self::$file    = $file;
			self::$version = (string) $version;
			add_action( 'admin_menu', array( __CLASS__, 'menu' ) );
			add_action( 'admin_post_' . self::OPTION, array( __CLASS__, 'save' ) );
			add_action( self::OPTION . '_daily', array( __CLASS__, 'check' ) );
			if ( ! wp_next_scheduled( self::OPTION . '_daily' ) ) {
				wp_schedule_event( time() + HOUR_IN_SECONDS, 'daily', self::OPTION . '_daily' );
			}
			if ( 'plugin' === self::KIND ) {
				add_filter( 'pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins', array( __CLASS__, 'plugin_update' ) );
				add_filter( 'plugins_api', array( __CLASS__, 'plugin_info' ), 20, 3 );
			} else {
				add_filter( 'pre_set_site_transient_update_themes', array( __CLASS__, 'theme_update' ) );
			}
		}

		/**
		 * Saved license: key, status, expires.
		 *
		 * @return array
		 */
		public static function data() {
			return wp_parse_args( (array) get_option( self::OPTION, array() ), array( 'key' => '', 'status' => '', 'expires' => '', 'message' => '' ) );
		}

		/**
		 * Whether the license is active (use this to turn your paid features on or off).
		 *
		 * @return bool
		 */
		public static function is_active() {
			return 'active' === self::data()['status'];
		}

		/**
		 * Call the store.
		 *
		 * @param string $route  activate, deactivate, check or update.
		 * @param string $key    License key.
		 * @return array|WP_Error
		 */
		private static function call( $route, $key ) {
			$args = array(
				'license_key' => $key,
				'site_url'    => home_url(),
				'slug'        => self::PRODUCT,
			);
			$response = 'update' === $route
				? wp_remote_get( add_query_arg( array_map( 'rawurlencode', $args ), self::API . 'license/update' ), array( 'timeout' => 15 ) )
				: wp_remote_post( self::API . 'license/' . $route, array( 'timeout' => 15, 'body' => $args ) );
			if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
				return $response;
			}
			$body = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ), true );
			return is_array( $body ) ? $body : new WP_Error( 'license', 'The license server did not answer.' );
		}

		/**
		 * Daily status check.
		 */
		public static function check() {
			$data = self::data();
			if ( '' === $data['key'] ) {
				return;
			}
			$result = self::call( 'check', $data['key'] );
			if ( is_wp_error( $result ) || empty( $result['status'] ) ) {
				return; // Keep the last known status when the store can't be reached.
			}
			$data['status']  = $result['status'];
			$data['expires'] = isset( $result['expires'] ) ? $result['expires'] : '';
			update_option( self::OPTION, $data );
		}

		/**
		 * License screen.
		 */
		public static function menu() {
			$title = sprintf( '%s license', '{{NAME}}' );
			if ( 'plugin' === self::KIND ) {
				add_options_page( $title, $title, 'manage_options', self::OPTION, array( __CLASS__, 'page' ) );
			} else {
				add_theme_page( $title, $title, 'manage_options', self::OPTION, array( __CLASS__, 'page' ) );
			}
		}

		/**
		 * The screen.
		 */
		public static function page() {
			$data = self::data();
			?>
			<div class="wrap">
				<h1><?php echo esc_html( '{{NAME}} license' ); ?></h1>
				<?php if ( '' !== $data['message'] ) : ?>
					<div class="notice notice-<?php echo self::is_active() ? 'success' : 'error'; ?>"><p><?php echo esc_html( $data['message'] ); ?></p></div>
				<?php endif; ?>
				<form method="post" action="<?php echo esc_url( admin_url( 'admin-post.php' ) ); ?>">
					<input type="hidden" name="action" value="<?php echo esc_attr( self::OPTION ); ?>" />
					<?php wp_nonce_field( self::OPTION ); ?>
					<table class="form-table"><tr>
						<th scope="row"><label for="license_key">License key</label></th>
						<td>
							<input type="text" class="regular-text code" id="license_key" name="license_key" value="<?php echo esc_attr( $data['key'] ); ?>" <?php disabled( self::is_active() ); ?> />
							<p class="description">
								<?php echo esc_html( self::is_active() ? 'Active' . ( $data['expires'] ? ', updates until ' . $data['expires'] : '' ) : 'Find your key in My Account > Licenses on {{STORE_NAME}}.' ); ?>
							</p>
						</td>
					</tr></table>
					<?php submit_button( self::is_active() ? 'Deactivate' : 'Activate', self::is_active() ? 'secondary' : 'primary', self::is_active() ? 'deactivate' : 'activate' ); ?>
				</form>
			</div>
			<?php
		}

		/**
		 * Activate or deactivate.
		 */
		public static function save() {
			if ( ! current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {
				wp_die( 'Not allowed.' );
			}
			check_admin_referer( self::OPTION );
			$data = self::data();
			if ( isset( $_POST['deactivate'] ) ) {
				self::call( 'deactivate', $data['key'] );
				$data = array( 'key' => '', 'status' => '', 'expires' => '', 'message' => 'License deactivated on this site.' );
			} else {
				$key    = isset( $_POST['license_key'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['license_key'] ) ) : '';
				$result = self::call( 'activate', $key );
				if ( is_wp_error( $result ) ) {
					$data['message'] = $result->get_error_message();
				} elseif ( ! empty( $result['success'] ) ) {
					$data = array( 'key' => $key, 'status' => 'active', 'expires' => isset( $result['expires'] ) ? $result['expires'] : '', 'message' => 'License activated. Updates are on.' );
				} else {
					$data['message'] = isset( $result['message'] ) ? $result['message'] : 'The key could not be activated.';
				}
			}
			update_option( self::OPTION, $data );
			delete_site_transient( 'plugin' === self::KIND ? 'update_plugins' : 'update_themes' );
			wp_safe_redirect( admin_url( ( 'plugin' === self::KIND ? 'options-general.php' : 'themes.php' ) . '?page=' . self::OPTION ) );
			exit;
		}

		/**
		 * Latest version from the store (cached for 6 hours).
		 *
		 * @return array|null
		 */
		private static function remote() {
			$data = self::data();
			if ( '' === $data['key'] ) {
				return null;
			}
			$cached = get_transient( self::OPTION . '_update' );
			if ( is_array( $cached ) ) {
				return $cached;
			}
			$result = self::call( 'update', $data['key'] );
			if ( is_wp_error( $result ) || empty( $result['version'] ) ) {
				return null;
			}
			set_transient( self::OPTION . '_update', $result, 6 * HOUR_IN_SECONDS );
			return $result;
		}

		/**
		 * Offer the update in Dashboard > Updates (plugin).
		 *
		 * @param object $transient Update data.
		 * @return object
		 */
		public static function plugin_update( $transient ) {
			$remote = self::remote();
			if ( ! is_object( $transient ) || ! $remote || version_compare( $remote['version'], self::$version, '<=' ) ) {
				return $transient;
			}
			$basename                         = plugin_basename( self::$file );
			$transient->response[ $basename ] = (object) array(
				'slug'         => self::PRODUCT,
				'plugin'       => $basename,
				'new_version'  => $remote['version'],
				'package'      => $remote['package'],
				'url'          => $remote['homepage'],
				'tested'       => $remote['tested'],
				'requires'     => $remote['requires'],
				'requires_php' => $remote['requires_php'],
			);
			return $transient;
		}

		/**
		 * "View details" popup (plugin).
		 *
		 * @param mixed  $result Result.
		 * @param string $action Action.
		 * @param object $args   Arguments.
		 * @return mixed
		 */
		public static function plugin_info( $result, $action, $args ) {
			if ( 'plugin_information' !== $action || empty( $args->slug ) || self::PRODUCT !== $args->slug ) {
				return $result;
			}
			$remote = self::remote();
			if ( ! $remote ) {
				return $result;
			}
			return (object) array(
				'name'          => '{{NAME}}',
				'slug'          => self::PRODUCT,
				'version'       => $remote['version'],
				'download_link' => $remote['package'],
				'homepage'      => $remote['homepage'],
				'tested'        => $remote['tested'],
				'requires'      => $remote['requires'],
				'requires_php'  => $remote['requires_php'],
				'sections'      => array( 'changelog' => $remote['changelog'] ),
			);
		}

		/**
		 * Offer the update in Dashboard > Updates (theme).
		 *
		 * @param object $transient Update data.
		 * @return object
		 */
		public static function theme_update( $transient ) {
			$remote = self::remote();
			if ( ! is_object( $transient ) || ! $remote || version_compare( $remote['version'], self::$version, '<=' ) ) {
				return $transient;
			}
			$transient->response[ self::PRODUCT ] = array(
				'theme'        => self::PRODUCT,
				'new_version'  => $remote['version'],
				'package'      => $remote['package'],
				'url'          => $remote['homepage'],
				'requires'     => $remote['requires'],
				'requires_php' => $remote['requires_php'],
			);
			return $transient;
		}
	}
}
